flags.parking-minimum: This parcel is in the R2-H zoning district, and off-street parking rules may apply that this tool does not verify; parking requirements can reduce how many homes fit on the lot [zoning.district].
flags.adu: Accessory dwelling units (small secondary housing units) are only allowed in a specific ADU overlay area with owner-occupancy and a one-per-lot limit, and whether this parcel is in that overlay is unverified [zoning.district].
flags.hazard-undermined: The entire parcel overlaps a mapped undermined area, meaning past underground mining may affect the ground below, so a geotechnical review is recommended [hazard.undermined].
flags.gap-financing: This parcel is in a neighborhood with low assessed land value, so projects here may likely need extra ('gap') financing beyond typical loans; this is a note, not a penalty to the score [hood.median_land_psf].
flags.phfa-infill: Because this is a vacant lot in a low land-value area, it may qualify for infill or blight-related scoring in PHFA (Pennsylvania Housing Finance Agency) funding applications, but this should be confirmed against current PHFA criteria [landuse.vacant, hood.median_land_psf].
flags.public-owner: The parcel is owned by the City, which may make it easier to acquire through a public disposition process, though this is not guaranteed [owner.type].
